dct_title_s: Map showing sub-division of lands north of Deaville Beach, Brick Township, Ocean County, New Jersey
dct_description_sm: This is a map of property lots north of Deauville Beach. Some of the housing lots are numbered, and some are labelled with their respective owners.
Source map supplied by New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
